fitted.units: BODY center ego x forward/y left, radians, side lengths meters; time 0.5:0.5:3

primary.frame: Metric local LiDAR; +y nominally forward, +x nominally right.
primary.object_decoder: Pinned VAD head CustomNMSFreeCoder/nuScenes output_to_nusc_box horizontal footprint. 0.5 s steps are per-mode XY displacements (cumulative sum from current center); future yaw and sizes unavailable.
primary.query_identity: Unique query_id within observation; a query can appear under several ranked classes.
